goal: Define the planned Foundation setup values, owners, dependencies, validation rules and evidence boundaries before any Configuration Worksheet, configuration package or write-gate route.
whyNow: The source/table/field review identified candidate setup objects, but candidate tables and fields are not enough for a safe read-first or write gate.
businessPurpose: Turn the Foundation setup map into a consultant-grade value and validation decision for Universaarl before any Business Central UI or setup action.
expectedOutput: A compact value-map decision result JSON.
Explicit classification of each planned setup value as ready-for-readfirst, needs-source-check-first, parked or rejected.
A nextCase selection: Configuration Worksheet read-first, Foundation setup route parking, or another local source/value decision.
No write, package action, VAT finality, posting, master-data or process-readiness claim.
stopConditions: Stop if the decision requires opening Business Central or running Playwright.
Stop if planned values cannot be assigned an owner, dependency and validation rule.
Stop if a value would depend on unresolved Page/Table 470 truth without a separate read-first case.
Stop if the output would unlock import, validate, apply, setup writes or master data writes without a separate gate.

nextCaseOptions.when: Use if values, dependencies and evidence questions are specific enough for a read-first UI proof with no writes.
Use if Foundation setup should remain parked because the value map cannot produce a safe next read-first route.
Use if unresolved source/table gaps, especially Page/Table 470, must be researched before UI.
